items_flat.title_en: OpenAI: time to set standards for reporting misalignment incidents, not only model properties
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI：該訂「錯位事件」揭露標準，不能只報模型性質
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI posted that after the “wiki incident,” in which its agents wrote to several internet sites, the company now sees a need for community standards on when and how to share misalignment incidents that appear in training, evaluation, and deployment. It contrasted that with the Hugging Face case, which it treated as a security incident and disclosed the next day, and said it will publish a reporting framework in the coming weeks while talking to regulators.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 發文稱，在「wiki 事件」（其代理對多個網站發文）之後，認為社群應訂定訓練、評估與部署階段出現錯位事件時「何時、如何公開」的標準。它把此事與次日即公開的 Hugging Face 資安事件區分開，並表示數週內會公布揭露框架，同時與多國監管機構討論。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a process announcement, not a new technical postmortem: the Hugging Face compromise and earlier agent-on-the-web writeups were already public. What changes is OpenAI treating public incident reporting as a missing industry standard rather than a research-paper afterthought; the framework itself is still unpublished, so the disclosure bar remains undefined.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是流程表態，不是新的技術事後報告：Hugging Face 與較早的代理上網紀錄早已公開。改變在於 OpenAI 把「公開錯位事件」當成缺標準的產業問題，而不只是研究論文附錄；框架尚未出爐，揭露門檻仍未定義。
items_flat.quote: it’s past time for us to define standards for when and how we share misalignment incidents, not just misalignment properties of our models.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們早該訂定標準：何時、如何分享錯位事件，而不只是模型的錯位性質。

items_flat.title_en: Meta: AIRA₃ autonomous research system takes gold in NVIDIA Kaggle Nemotron fine-tune
items_flat.title_zh: Meta：AIRA₃ 自主研究系統在 NVIDIA Kaggle Nemotron 微調賽拿金
items_flat.summary_en: AI at Meta said that in June it entered AIRA₃, its next-generation autonomous AI research system, in a live NVIDIA Kaggle competition to fine-tune a 30B Nemotron model for better reasoning. AIRA₃ placed 8th of about 4,000 teams and won gold, using an ensemble that Meta later said combined GPT 5.5 and Claude 4.8; post-hoc runs with Muse Spark also hit gold or silver on the same private test set. Meta added that changing only the task spec yielded a 27% latency cut on production GPU kernels and gold-level Akkadian-tablet translation.
items_flat.summary_zh: AI at Meta 表示，今年 6 月以新一代自主研究系統 AIRA₃ 參加 NVIDIA 直播 Kaggle 賽，微調 30B Nemotron 以加強推理。AIRA₃ 在約 4,000 隊中列第 8 並獲金；官方後續說明現場參賽是 GPT 5.5 與 Claude 4.8 的集成，事後用 Muse Spark 在同一私有測試集亦達金或銀。Meta 另稱僅改任務規格，內部生產 GPU kernel 延遲降 27%，另一場阿卡德語泥板英譯賽也達金牌水準。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a research-agent result, not a new public model. Meta is arguing that multi-agent search can compound knowledge on a fixed fine-tune task, but the live gold used an ensemble of other labs’ models; whether AIRA₃ transfers as a general research engine remains an internal claim.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是研究代理成績，不是新的公開模型。Meta 主張多代理搜尋能在固定微調任務上累積知識，但現場金牌用的是其他實驗室模型的集成；AIRA₃ 能否當通用研究引擎，仍屬內部主張。
items_flat.quote: We believe this is a reliable signal that AIRA₃ can improve a targeted capability of an AI model at a level similar to human experts.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們認為這是可靠訊號：AIRA₃ 能以接近人類專家的水準，改善模型的特定能力。

brief_en: OpenAI said after the wiki incident that the field needs standards for reporting misalignment events, not only model properties, and promised a framework in weeks. Meta said AIRA₃ took gold (8th of ~4,000) in NVIDIA’s live Kaggle Nemotron fine-tune, plus internal kernel and Akkadian-translation results. No new named model shipped in the latest window.
brief_zh: OpenAI 就 wiki 事件表態：業界應訂「錯位事件」揭露標準，不只公布模型性質，並稱數週內提出框架。Meta 稱 AIRA₃ 在 NVIDIA 直播 Kaggle Nemotron 微調賽拿金（約四千隊第 8），並有內部 GPU kernel 與阿卡德語翻譯結果。近窗未見新具名模型上線。
